{
  "dataset_name": "electricity",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "nsw_price_demand_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of NSW price to NSW demand, capturing supply-demand pressure in a scale-normalized way.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a meaningful axis for neighborhood grouping based on market pressure conditions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswprice / (nswdemand + 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vic_price_demand_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of VIC price to VIC demand, analogous market pressure feature for Victoria.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides parallel market-pressure dimension for KNN distance balancing.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "vicprice / (vicdemand + 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "interstate_price_gap",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between NSW and VIC normalized prices, indicating cross-region price divergence.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Sharpens neighborhood geometry by separating rows with similar within-region but different cross-region prices.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(nswprice - vicprice)"
    },
    {
      "name": "interstate_demand_gap",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed difference of NSW minus VIC demand reflecting load imbalance between states.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures directional demand imbalance relevant to transfer dynamics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswdemand - vicdemand"
    },
    {
      "name": "transfer_centered",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Transfer flow centered on its midpoint to highlight net flow direction.",
      "value_range": [-0.5, 0.5],
      "feature_family": "centering",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Makes transfer flow symmetric for distance calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "transfer - 0.5"
    },
    {
      "name": "period_cyclic_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cyclic distance of period from midday (0.5), reflecting how far the time-of-day is from peak demand window.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.5],
      "feature_family": "cyclic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a symmetric time-of-day descriptor improving neighborhood matching for similar load periods.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.minimum(np.abs(period - 0.5), 1.0 - np.abs(period - 0.5))"
    },
    {
      "name": "peak_period_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for periods within typical peak demand windows (mid-morning and evening).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cluster indicator improving KNN separation between peak and off-peak rows.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((period >= 0.33) & (period <= 0.46) | (period >= 0.66) & (period <= 0.83), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_demand_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Joint indicator flagging high demand across both NSW and VIC simultaneously.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes a co-stress regime that creates discrete cluster geometry for KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((nswdemand > 0.55) & (vicdemand > 0.55), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "price_log_scale",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled NSW price to compress extreme price spikes for distance calculations.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces dominance of price outliers in Euclidean distance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(nswprice * 10.0) / np.log1p(10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_typical_row",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance from row to the unsupervised global mean prototype across key normalized features.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an unsupervised outlier-distance signal that aids KNN weighting and tie-breaking.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt((nswprice - 0.0599)**2 + (nswdemand - 0.4336)**2 + (vicdemand - 0.4262)**2 + (transfer - 0.499)**2 + (period - 0.5086)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "price_demand_coherence",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of whether NSW and VIC price-demand patterns move coherently versus divergently, computed as a normalized similarity score combining sign-agreement of deviations from each variable's mean.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes a market-regime coherence signal that improves clustering of structurally similar market states.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "market_stress_level",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic ordinal indicator (low=0.0, moderate=0.5, high=1.0) of overall electricity market stress combining elevated prices, high demand, and unusual transfer flows, derived from row values relative to training-set typical ranges.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_regime",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a coarse regime cluster indicator that helps KNN group rows by market condition severity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
